body.x: ISAW Action Cam has launched its brand in 2012 and having its distribution around 40 countries around the globe now.
Although it's been only a year since they lunched their first brand, it has got a lot of attention from the market side and growing its ISAW brand day by day.

ISAW is the first action cam from Korea and it has proved its quality through the great events in domestic, and ISAW now plans to join in more events worldwide in next year. For the start, it will have event from DAKAR Rally S.America in Chile in coming January 2013.

ISAW has released its Full HD Action Cam, ISAW A2 back in August. A2 is very competitive in the market with great performance of the camera, and in CES, we will launch its new model, and its name is ISAW A3 Monster.

ISAW A3 Monster is one of the highest performance action cam in the market and it supports FULL HD 60 frames per second recording with 12 Mega Pixel Sony Exmor Sensor. A3 also supports LCD monitor for LIVE Screen and PLAYBACK, and it has WIFI connection to your smart phone, provides full control of the camera.

For the key features of ISAW A3 Monster, Great body design with solid black color, supports 1080p full hd 60 frames per second recording, 12 Mega Pixel Camera with great visibility f/2.0 glass lens. 240 frames per second high speed recording, Built in LCD, Built in WIFI, 3 hours of Battery run time, MIC IN, HDMI, 160ft Waterproof housing, 6 kinds of mounting accessories, and great value of 349 dollar MSRP available in United States.

From 2013, ISAW will be seriously approaching to US market. US market is the biggest and the most active action cam market around world now. ISAW A3 will be very successful with its best falue and the best quality.
ALL ISAW Action Cam are fully manufactured in Korea and it serves you with the best quality.
